Portsmouth is a thriving area with strong demand for reliable full bathroom installation and fitting services. Local properties range from period Victorian and Edwardian homes through to modern new-build developments, each presenting different plumbing requirements and challenges.

Our Gas Safe registered engineers serve all areas of Portsmouth and the surrounding Hampshire region. Whether you're in the town centre or the surrounding residential areas, we provide prompt, professional bathroom installation services with transparent pricing and no hidden call-out charges.

With years of experience working across Hampshire, our engineers understand the specific plumbing challenges faced by local homeowners. From the older pipe infrastructure common in period properties to the modern systems found in newer developments, our team has the expertise to handle any full bathroom installation and fitting requirement.

We cover all postcodes across Portsmouth with same-day availability for urgent work. All our engineers are fully qualified, insured, and committed to leaving your property clean and tidy after every job.

faqs.q: Can you move the toilet and bath to different positions?
faqs.a: Yes, but it depends on the soil pipe route and floor structure. Moving a toilet more than a metre from the existing soil stack requires a new soil pipe connection and increases cost significantly.

faqs.q: How much does a bathroom installation cost?
faqs.a: Labour for a full bathroom installation typically ranges from £2,500 to £5,000 depending on complexity. Suite and tile costs are separate. A complete bathroom renovation including all materials typically costs £4,000 to £10,000+.

faqs.q: Should I supply my own bathroom suite or let the plumber supply it?
faqs.a: You can do either. Supplying your own suite gives you more choice and control over the brand and style. Your installer may offer trade discounts worth 15-30% off RRP if they supply.

faqs.q: What guarantees should I expect on a bathroom installation?
faqs.a: Expect a minimum 12-month labour guarantee. Manufacturer warranties on suites and fittings typically run 5-25 years depending on the brand. Get all guarantees in writing.

localParagraph: Portsmouth, Hampshire, presents a genuinely varied landscape for bathroom installation, with housing stock ranging from Victorian terraces in Southsea and period properties around Old Portsmouth to post-war semis in Paulsgrove and modern new-builds on Portsea Island. This diversity means that experienced bathroom installers need to adapt their approach considerably — older homes often require updated pipework and structural consideration, while newer properties may demand more precise tiling and contemporary fitting work. Water hardness in Portsmouth sits within a mixed range, which influences product and material choices; homeowners should consider limestone-resistant fixtures and quality sealants to extend the lifespan of taps, showerheads, and grout over time. A professional bathroom fitter working across Portsmouth will also be familiar with the compact room dimensions typical of many terraced and semi-detached homes in areas like Milton and Fratton, where thoughtful layout planning makes a significant difference to the finished result. Choosing a locally experienced installer ensures these regional nuances are properly understood from the outset.
whatItInvolves: A full bathroom installation covers everything from stripping out the existing suite to fitting the new one — including all pipework, waste connections, tiling preparation, flooring, and electrical work for lighting and extraction. A quality bathroom installation transforms one of the most-used rooms in your home and typically adds 3-5% to your property value.
process: The process starts with a detailed survey to assess existing pipework, drainage routes, and structural considerations. Day 1-2: strip out and prep. Day 3-4: first fix plumbing and any structural work. Day 5-7: suite installation, tiling, and second fix. Day 8-10: finishing, sealant, and final inspection. You'll be without a working bathroom for 5-10 days depending on complexity — we'll agree a realistic timeline upfront.
whatToExpect: Expect a detailed written quote covering labour, waste disposal, and any structural work. Suite and tiles are usually supplied separately by you or sourced through us. All plumbing work is carried out to Water Regulations standards. A bathroom installation is a major investment — ask to see previous work and Gas Safe registration before committing to any installer.
